title: Portage deployment registry
description: One entry per LiteLLM deployment. src/portage/render_config.py validates portage-local/registry.yaml (or config/profiles/*.example.registry.yaml) against this schema before rendering. See HB-0-gateway-foundation.md Step 1.

alias.description: One of the seven fixed capability aliases (HB-0 'Fixed decisions'). No others are valid — the ladder is closed by design.

provider_route.description: The LiteLLM provider prefix this entry renders under (e.g. 'ollama_chat/<model_id>'). 'ollama_chat', never 'ollama' — HB-0 fixed decision.

model_id.description: The model identifier without the provider prefix, e.g. 'qwen3-coder:7b' or 'z-ai/glm-5.2'.

endpoint.description: Required for provider_route: ollama_chat. An os.environ/ reference to a Tailscale hostname (never a literal hostname or IP, never a secret value) so the registry stays portable across machines. Enforced in render_config.py, not pure JSON Schema, since it's conditional on provider_route.

order.description: Failover order within this alias's deployment group. Required when an alias has more than one enabled entry (checked in render_config.py, since JSON Schema can't see sibling array items).

license.description: The model's license class (e.g. 'Apache-2.0', 'MIT'). Use the literal string 'UNVERIFIED' when the license hasn't been confirmed yet — never guess a specific license name, since this field feeds the open-weight allowlist check (specs/09 R2).

thinking_disabled_for_structured.description: Optional. True when this deployment must have thinking/reasoning turned off for structured/JSON/tool calls (e.g. Gemma 4 E4B per HB-0 Step 1). Absent means not applicable.

stream_tools.description: Optional. Set to false by HB-0 Step 4 (tests/test_toolcalls.py) if this deployment's tool calls work non-streaming but fail to reconstruct correctly under stream: true. Absent means untested or known-good under both.

data_classification.description: CW02-decisions.md D15's enum. Full enforcement is HB-2 scope; the field exists at HB-0 so the registry doesn't need a breaking schema change later.

benchmark_version.description: Which BFCLv3/IFEval run this row's numbers came from, e.g. a dated harness run or a cited public leaderboard snapshot. Null when bfclv3/ifeval are both null.

bfclv3.description: Berkeley Function-Calling Leaderboard v3 score. Selection rule (HB-0 Step 1): any sub-4B model doing tool/function calls needs ~50+ here. Null means not yet measured — never fabricate a number.

ifeval.description: IFEval instruction-following score. Null means not yet measured.

enabled.description: false entries are validated and kept in the registry but excluded from the rendered model_list (HB-0: proprietary_code/proprietary_research exist disabled so HB-2's rescue path flips a flag instead of adding config).
